set.body:
Fifteen empty-guard constant sites across main sources. Full analysis:
post-01M16TXQZ2B5Q7E3TPRWN0R010.

THE FINDING IS THE ABSENCE OF A CONVENTION, proved by two pairs:
  cost.scala:247 lexicalJaccard -> 1.0 on empty (max distance, conservative)
  cost.scala:700 dSens          -> 0.0 on empty (min distance, flattering)
  Same file, both distances, opposite conventions.

  SoftCompatibility.scala:43 frameOverlap      -> 1.0 on empty (flattering)
  SoftCompatibility.scala:47 argumentAgreement -> 0.0 on empty (conservative)
  Adjacent methods, same object, both higher-is-better, opposite conventions.

Two adjacent methods cannot both be applying a policy. Each site was chosen locally and none is
reviewable afterwards, because nothing distinguishes a deliberate degenerate-case decision from
a value typed to stop the compiler complaining.

CONFIRMED FLATTERING (no evidence indistinguishable from a strong positive finding):
  cost.scala:700           dSens 0.0        no sensory terms reads as perfect match
  cost.scala:691           dEnt 0.5         unspecified entities read as mid-agreement
  SoftCompatibility:43     frameOverlap 1.0 no frames reads as total overlap
  SoftCompatibility:78     agreement 1.0    no shared keys reads as total agreement
  story/trajectory.scala:67 turnover 0.0    no entities either side reads as NO ENTITY CHANGE

trajectory.scala:67 is the worst placed: entity turnover drives BOUNDARY DETECTION, so absent
entity data suppresses a boundary, and it is indistinguishable from identical entities.

CONFIRMED NOT A DEFECT: hsmm.scala:650 and :658 (pIn/pStay 1.0 on empty sources) are FORCED --
with no source transitions the walk must go external with certainty and the src term list is
empty anyway. Do not patch these.

UNCLASSIFIED, not claimed: signature.scala:264/:463/:464/:466, StorySourceView.scala:236,
induce.scala:203/:335, SoftCompatibility.scala:47. Empty denominators whose direction I have not
established. START HERE -- classify these before patching the five above, because the sweep's
value is the convention, not the patch count.

THE REAL FIX is not fifteen patches. An empty input is INELIGIBLE, not observed-at-a-convenient
-value. This is what MetricObservation = Ineligible | Observed | Missing exists for, and it is
the strongest argument yet for adding the missing Ineligible arm to Estimate (31 sites, 6
modules). Once the type can say ineligible, there is no constant left to choose.

Depends on the d_sens wire-format work (bd-01M16S2Y6YS82TE6WBWQPKNZR3) for the Sensory case, but
the other four sites are independent of it.
set.title: sweep: the empty-denominator family - fifteen sites, two conventions, no policy
